S04.summary: S04: coherent orchestration and traceability. Server: explicit job claim flow (POST /api/jobs/{id}/claim, idempotent for same simulator, 409 for foreign live owners, recovery on expired heartbeat, adoption of unowned sessions), TaskService with transition rules and session ownership (PUT /api/tasks/{id}/status), optimistic concurrency via Version fields on Job/MachiningTask/SimulationSession (409 concurrent_modification), heartbeat expiry monitor marking stale sessions Faulted with owner-heartbeat revival, X-Correlation-Id middleware on all commands/logs/events, TaskStateChanged SignalR event, new error codes (session_not_owned, session_already_claimed, job_not_claimable, invalid_task_transition). Simulator: no more implicit job creation - claims existing runnable jobs, maps pallet slots to backend tasks and reports Running/Completed, sends simulatorId/heartbeats, shows connection/session status, clearly labelled local-only offline demo that never writes to the server. HMI: task traceability (job/session/task ids, pallet, slot, heartbeat, faulted badge), TaskStateChanged live task refresh, duplicate-start fix, command error feedback, en/de/fr i18n. Docs: docs/architecture/ORCHESTRATION.md added, CONTRACTS.md and README updated, TS contracts regenerated.

S06.summary: S06: robot catalog and selectable profiles. Added src/robot/catalog with RobotDefinition/JointDefinition/ToolDefinition contracts, validation (schema, exactly 6 joints, min<max finite joint limits, positive payload/reach, duplicate-id rejection, asset resolution against a procedural asset registry) and a RobotCatalogService with three license-safe generic six-axis profiles (compact 3kg/0.7m, medium 12kg/1.4m, heavy 50kg/2.0m), optional vendor metadata for educational comparison, and end-effector definitions with payload-based compatibility. The current robot is migrated as the default medium-6axis compatibility profile (identical dimensions and joint limits). IndustrialRobot now accepts per-profile joint limits and ScaledRobotComponent is driven by a RobotDefinition, so switching profiles re-mounts the same component with a fresh RobotController (configuration, not scene rewrite; one common controller interface). Added RobotCatalogPanel selection UI + a WebGL-free harness (?view=robot-catalog) for deterministic visual regression. Docs: docs/architecture/ROBOT_CATALOG.md added, EQUIPMENT_SDK.md and README updated.
